remarks:
Location Location Location! Meet CMK Builder's popular model, the "CAMERON". Welcome to your opportunity to build the home of your dreams on a beautiful 1.19-acre lot in the highly sought-after Clarence School District. This thoughtfully designed 2,402 sq. ft. home offers the perfect blend of comfort, style, and modern efficiency. Choose from one of the builder’s popular model plans or work together to customize the design to fit your own specifications.
This spacious home features 3 bedrooms and 2.5 baths, including a first-floor primary suite with a large walk-in closet, offering convenience and privacy. The open floor plan creates an inviting atmosphere with a bright sunroom just off the kitchen, perfect for enjoying morning coffee or relaxing while overlooking the backyard. A first-floor den provides flexible space and could easily serve as a fourth bedroom, office, or study.
The main living areas showcase luxury vinyl plank flooring, while the kitchen and bathrooms feature your choice of granite or quartz countertops and quality KraftMaid soft-close cabinetry. The living room is anchored by a gas fireplace with a cultured stone surround extending to the ceiling, creating a warm and elegant focal point.
Additional highlights include 8-foot ceilings on every level—including the basement, tiled bathrooms, convenient first-floor laundry, and a basement egress window allowing for future finishing possibilities.
Exterior features are equally impressive with a covered 12’ x 4’ front porch, covered 12’ x 15’ rear porch, 2-car garage with insulated door, and a 100-foot blacktop driveway. Built with quality and efficiency in mind, the home includes Andersen windows, a high-efficiency furnace, 50-gallon hot water tank, and a durable 50-year architectural shingle roof.
This is a rare chance to build a beautiful new home with quality finishes on a spacious lot located just steps from the bike path in a prime location.
